pkgmetadata.longdescription: Omarchy user defaults ported from omacom/omarchy: the config source of truth under /usr/share/omarchy, /etc/skel seeding for new users, package owned /etc drop-ins guarded by portage CONFIG_PROTECT, systemd user units, SDDM/Plymouth theming data, fonts and branding. The Arch-specific boot stack (mkinitcpio, limine, plymouthd.conf, faillock, nsswitch) is deliberately filtered out; see the overlay README for the full mapping.
